description: The corner residence's private head, cut from the same monolithic grey stone as the great bath outside — one seamless block, wet-room floor, a rain shower set into the ceiling with no visible fitting. A sculpted basin, a low concealed toilet, the city turning slowly past a slot of frosted glass. Warm underfoot, and utterly quiet. The privacy bolt seats with a soft magnetic click.
name: Residence 30-B — Ensuite
